scope: Bounded read-only public HTTP GETs; no screenshots, telemetry, account access, scheduled checks or external writes.
limitations: Successful public and synthetic requests do not verify real bot access or IP identity.
Search indexing, citations, recommendations, external adoption and real crawler visits are unmeasured.
Cloudflare account settings, WAF rules and request logs were not accessed by this checker.
No external links are fetched; human routes are checked as HTTP HTML, without client-side rendering.
A supplied manifest pin connects hashes to a prior release record; without a pin, hashes establish only consistency with the served manifest.

crawlerSources.note: Search, training and user-directed agents have independent purposes. User-directed ChatGPT requests may not apply robots.txt.
Documents three robot tokens and robots.txt support; does not specify complete HTTP User-Agent strings.
